title: Don't show events for the current day that are in the past
line: The Digital Clock's event list for today no longer shows events that have already ended.
explanation: The agenda in the Digital Clock popup showed every event returned for the selected day, so on today's date it kept listing meetings that were already over. The change filters today's list to all-day events and timed events whose end is still in the future, and uses a timer (set to the next end time, at most an hour) plus a refresh when the popup opens so events drop out as they end. Other days still show all their events.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: hide today's events that have already ended

The agenda listed every event of the selected day, so today's view kept
showing meetings that were already over. Today's list now leaves out
timed events that have ended, and updates itself when the next one ends.

BUG: 379198

media.caption: Master: today's list still shows "Early ended event" (00:30-01:00) and "Ended 10 min ago" at 4:13 PM.
With the fix at 4:14 PM: only the multi-day, all-day, in-progress and upcoming events are listed.
